reasoning.text: Reproducibility is moderate: the spec pins the full functional parameter set (N, q=12289, psi/omega/Ninv, Barrett mu/k, 8 BU, 14-bit widths) so the two impls agree almost everywhere, but the paper's headline structures — the conflict-free Sec.III bank/offset map, the natural-order no-bit-reversal addressing, the fused 2-mult radix-4 schedule, and a consistent FSM and Barrett-correction bound — are source-missing, forcing shared reconstructions. Fidelity is mid: every recoverable parameter matches and the negacyclic round-trip identity holds, but the system's actual differentiators (no bit-reversal, the specific conflict-free mapping, the symmetric-operator savings) are violated or unverifiable, so the impls are closer to a generic correct negacyclic NTT than to the precise CFNTT architecture.
gaps: [operation] Paper Sec.III conflict-free bank()/offset() functions (the headline result; spec carries only a committed XOR-fold reconstruction marked [conv])
[operation] Per-stage crossbar permutation sigma_s table that achieves bank-conflict-free 8-lane access
[operation] Rearranged-loop twiddle-ROM addressing that yields true natural-order I/O with NO bit-reversal anywhere
[operation] Concrete 2-modular-multiplication symmetric-operator radix-4 butterfly formula (only counts 2/3, 8/10 are given)
[control] Authoritative FSM/state-machine transition table and per-stage cycle schedule (three contradictory versions present)
[operation] Exact Barrett correction bound — number of conditional subtractions (spec says 'exactly 2', '<=2', and 'one' in different places)
[param] Naive radix-4 add/sub baseline that the 20% reduction is measured against
[port] Host PCIe/DMA/AXI-Stream interface protocol, handshake and beat-packing (declared reproduction-invented, omitted by both)
[timing] 9-cycle pipeline latency as a cycle-accurate model (carried only as a scalar, not a timing semantics)
[operation] 8-way simultaneous (single-cycle) bank-distinctness guarantee — both only prove pairwise per-operand distinctness
